verdict.rationale: Orb's docs describe several ways to validate changes before they affect live billing: testing pricing changes against historical usage, previewing invoice impact before saving subscription edits, backfilling and replaying events, and running in parallel with Stripe during validation. None of the evidence describes an isolated sandbox or test-mode environment kept separate from production data. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or test API keys, guidance on isolating test data from production, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
